3-roll shear mixer is the most efficient dispersion technique for low weight percent VGCNFs loading in SC-1 resin and the mechanical performance of SC- 1/VGCNFs composite is significantly improved at 0.2wt.% of loading.

the dispersion of VGCNF in SC-1 resin can be improved using the Thinky mixing and solvent mixing techniques, and the mechanical properties of the epoxy resin can be improved by the addition of VGCNFs.
the optimum dispersion technique for VGCNF in SC-1 Epoxy is 3-roll shear mixed VGCNF dispersed in SC-1 resin.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the dispersion of VGCNF in SC-1 Epoxy, and their effect on the flexural and thermal properties of SC-1 E-40.
the development of a new epoxy resin with improved properties by incorporating a small percentage of VGCNF.
the dispersion and characterization of VGCNFs in SC-1 Epoxy resin and their effect on its properties.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the Thinky mixing technique is a better option for dispersing carbon nanofibre in SC-1 resin than ultrasonication, and that the solvent mixing technique is the best method for dispersion at low loading.
Thinky mixing with ultrasonication and 3-roll mixing is the best method for the dispersion of VGCNF in SC-1 Epoxy.
the Thinky mixing method with solvent is the best method for dispersion of VGCNF in SC-1 resin.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the optimum method for the dispersion of VGCNF in SC-1 resin was found to be the combination of ultrasonication with Thinky mixer.
the optimum technique for dispersion of VGCNFs in SC-1 is by mixing with a solvent, followed by 3-roll shear and ultrasonic mixing.
the best method of dispersion is to premix the VGCNFs with SC-1 epoxy and then mix with a Thinky mixer, which gives a better performance than neat SC-1 resin.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the dispersion method has a significant effect on the performance and properties of the nanocomposite.
the use of a solvent for dispersion and mixing with the epoxy is the best method to disperse VGCNFs uniformly.
the dispersion method used is very important for nanocomposites and the results obtained should be carefully analysed before making any conclusions.
